description: BlitzReels helps you turn recordings into short videos. In ChatGPT, you can find existing projects and media, import a video you have permission to use, create captioned clips, edit timelines, generate video assets, and export finished files. Actions use your connected BlitzReels workspace and ask for confirmation before sensitive imports or likeness use.

defaultPrompt: Turn this video into three short clips with captions.
Create a vertical video from this idea.
